prompt: Map the significant nodes and routes of a ruin with several approaches to its central objective. Labeled fixture — not vault canon.
expected_output: A decision graph with loops, bypasses, retreats, and route tradeoffs; no-topology or purely linear maps fail.

assertions.text: Presents nodes and edges before room or landmark prose
Includes at least one meaningful loop, bypass, and retreat or safe return where plausible
Explains cost, information, danger, or consequence of important edges
